grade.verdict_quote: Not ready to merge — 8 acceptance-criteria failures found ... I'd send this back rather than merge.

E1.quote: `.summary` has an unconditional `min-width: 400px`, so at 375px the page horizontally scrolls (scrollWidth 420 vs viewport 375), violating "nothing scrolls horizontally."
E1.evidence: node scripts/_check_layout.mjs → 'width=375: scrollWidth=420 clientWidth=375 horizontalOverflow=true cartFlexDirection=column'

E2.quote: Breakpoint is `min-width: 769px`, so at exactly 768px (which the ticket names as the threshold) the layout is still stacked, not two-column.
E2.evidence: node scripts/_check_layout.mjs → 'width=768: scrollWidth=768 clientWidth=768 horizontalOverflow=false cartFlexDirection=column'

E3.quote: so qty can go to ... 11 (12 clicks of +) before the button finally disables — one step too late in both directions.
E3.evidence: node scripts/_check_tmp.mjs → 'qty after 12 clicks of inc: 11' / 'inc disabled now? true'

E4.quote: so qty can go to **0** (click − once at qty=1) ... before the button finally disables — one step too late in both directions.
E4.evidence: node scripts/_check_tmp.mjs → 'dec disabled at qty=1? false' / 'qty after clicking dec at 1: 0'

E5.quote: Discount is stored as a frozen cents amount at apply-time and never recalculated, so it does **not** "follow later quantity changes" as required — confirmed: applied SAVE10 ($105.30), then incremented qty, discount stayed at $105.30 while subtotal moved to $1,182.00.
E5.evidence: node scripts/_check_tmp.mjs → 'discount after SAVE10: −$105.30' ... 'discount after qty+1 (should change if it follows): −$105.30' ... 'subtotal after qty+1: $1182.00'

E6.quote: "Code not recognised" is never cleared when a subsequent valid code is applied — the error message stays on screen after successfully applying SAVE10.
E6.evidence: node scripts/_check_tmp.mjs → 'error after good code: Code not recognised hidden= false'

E7.quote: `formatMoney` has no thousands separator. Default cart subtotal renders `$1053.00` instead of `$1,053.00`.
E7.evidence: node scripts/_check_tmp.mjs → 'subtotal text (default cart, should be $1,053.00): $1053.00'

E8.quote: `app.js` toggles a class `is-hidden` on `#summary`, but that class doesn't exist in `cart.css`. Emptying the cart shows "Your cart is empty" *alongside* a fully visible Order summary and Checkout button
E8.evidence: node scripts/_check_final2.mjs → 'summary computed display: block' (after removing all 3 lines); plus Read of /tmp/cart-empty.png screenshot at step [25]

E9.quote: `save()` is only called from the Remove handler, not from the inc/dec handlers, so quantity changes are lost on reload (confirmed: qty 1→2, reload, back to 1). Only removals persist.
E9.evidence: node scripts/_check_final2.mjs → 'qty before reload: 2 qty after reload: 1'
